name: Mobbin UI Camera
move: minimal partner lockup gives way to a wide product canvas; the camera focuses the prompt controls, then pulls back as mobile references fan into view
how: The opening uses clipped text and a disciplined cross-lockup. A faint blue canvas wipes upward and the camera begins deliberately wide. It eases toward the prompt using an expoInOut focus move; menu rows appear one at a time, the cursor chooses Reference from Mobbin, and the camera then pulls backward while a staggered row of phone cards expands from the control. The active phone remains sharp while its neighbors carry depth blur, producing a rack-focus feel without video footage.
adapt: Replace the partner names, prompt actions and phone-card DOM. Keep the initial restraint, the focus move toward the single control, and the pullback that reveals the result scale.
port: Mount one oversized .world and drive its {x,y,zoom} target with Motion.camera. Cards and menu rows are scoped DOM nodes whose stagger is calculated from the seek time.
caveats: Phone designs are intentionally generic DOM recreations
Anything's native italic wordmark is approximated with Sorts Mill Goudy
